ipc_a610_diagnostic.operator_action: Isolate PCB immediately. Use microscope with 0.8mm desoldering braid and RMA flux at 350Â°C to wick excess bridge.
ipc_a610_diagnostic.root_cause: Over-exposure in photolithography or excessive solder wave depth / flux exhaustion.

ipc_a610_diagnostic.classification: IPC-A-610 Class 2/3 Process Indicator (Defect if clearance < 0.1mm)
ipc_a610_diagnostic.operator_action: Micro-scrape copper nodule using precision scalpel under 10x magnification if conductor spacing is compromised.
ipc_a610_diagnostic.root_cause: Dry film photoresist pinhole or particulate contamination during laminating.

ipc_a610_diagnostic.classification: IPC-A-610 Defect if conductor cross-section reduced by > 20%
ipc_a610_diagnostic.operator_action: Measure trace width. If reduction < 20%, touch up with UV-curable green mask polymer; otherwise route to scrap.
ipc_a610_diagnostic.root_cause: Abrasive contact on automated conveyor belts or rough mechanical handling during racking.

ipc_a610_diagnostic.operator_action: Mark trace fault. Apply copper jumper wire (AWG 30) soldered to adjacent through-hole vias if rework permitted, else scrap.
ipc_a610_diagnostic.root_cause: Over-etching in cupric chloride bath or air bubble blockage during acid etching.

ipc_a610_diagnostic.classification: IPC-A-610 Defect if remaining trace width fails minimum electrical clearance
ipc_a610_diagnostic.operator_action: Inspect remaining conductor width against CAD layout. If within 80% tolerance, apply conformal coating.
ipc_a610_diagnostic.root_cause: Developing chemical foaming or photoresist chipping during high-pressure water spray rinse.

ipc_a610_diagnostic.classification: IPC-A-610 Class 3 Defect (Annular ring breakout > 90 degrees)
ipc_a610_diagnostic.operator_action: Reject board for Class 3 aerospace/automotive builds. Quota sample drill batch for tool inspection.
ipc_a610_diagnostic.root_cause: CNC spindle runout, drill bit eccentricity, or misaligned optical registration targets.

ipc_a610_diagnostic.classification: IPC-A-610 Process Indicator / Defect depending on voltage insulation requirements
ipc_a610_diagnostic.operator_action: Measure minimum spacing. Flag for high-voltage dielectric withstand test if spacing < 0.125mm.
ipc_a610_diagnostic.root_cause: Uneven etching rate due to spray nozzle clogging in the etching chamber.

ipc_a610_diagnostic.classification: IPC-A-610 Defect if ground plane or critical return path interrupted
ipc_a610_diagnostic.operator_action: Verify if missing copper affects high-speed impedance traces. If non-functional void, document as waiver.
ipc_a610_diagnostic.root_cause: Severe localized chemical leaching or base laminate surface oil contamination prior to plating.

ipc_a610_diagnostic.classification: IPC-A-610 Class 1/2 Acceptable, Class 3 Process Indicator
ipc_a610_diagnostic.operator_action: Apply manual UV solder mask touch-up pen and UV cure for 60 seconds before wave soldering.
ipc_a610_diagnostic.root_cause: Insufficient UV exposure energy or contaminated silkscreen squeegee.
